message:
Blog post slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters: "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including the previously failing one.

The fix is in `src/blog/slug.js`. It decomposes the title with Unicode NFKD normalization and strips the combining accent marks before calling the vendored slugify. I didn't edit `vendor/slugify`, because its header and `vendor/README.md` say not to hand-edit vendored code. The wrapper also covers only blog posts. `src/shop/product-url.js` uses the same vendored slugify, so product URLs still drop accented letters. Fixing those would mean changing the shop's URLs too, so I left them alone. Say if you want that covered as well.

I didn't commit anything.
